snippet.title: Blue vs Red: One Valleyball Match, Kickoff to Buzzer
snippet.description:
Blue against Red: one five-minute match of Valleyball Versus, from kickoff to the final buzzer, cut down to 2:33. It's built around the moments that mattered, including the ones that never ended in a goal.

Play free: https://ValleyballVS.com
Inaugural Championship: December 27, 2026

Both athletes are the game's own bots, Blue on Hard and Red on Medium, so nothing here is scripted. The match ran in the real physics engine on Valleyball Versus v4.0, then was replayed with film cameras. The opening shots and the two replays are in slow motion. Everything else is real time.

THE RULES
Put the ball through the giant ring to score. Every goal flips the court, so you attack the other end next. Matches last five minutes. There is no out of bounds, no whistles and no auto-aim. Where you stand and when you swing decide every shot.

CHAPTERS
0:00 The arena
0:17 Kickoff
0:31 The pile-up
0:45 The first goal
0:59 The foot race
1:09 Spike and dive
1:33 21 seconds, unbroken
1:49 The second goal
2:01 The last minute
2:20 Full time

Music: "Origins of Red VS Blue"
